verdicts.reason: A: the headline stays dominant and the sea-and-sunglasses scene survives. But the white Meridian logo sits outside the panel on pale sky with weak contrast. The blue panel bleeds off the top and right edges. The badge collides with the panel edge, the CTA comes before its body copy, and there is a dead gap under the headline. B: the logo is blown up to rival or beat the headline, which breaks the hierarchy. The 'Up to 40% off' badge is squashed into a distorted ellipse, and the badge and CTA sit at the very top above the brand and headline, so the reading order is wrong. The sunglasses float out of context on the blue panel and most of the scene is lost, so B strays further from the original.
